### Learning goals

- What challenges you can run into when creating analysis pipelines
  with regular Bash scripts, including runner scripts.
- What "workflow management systems" like Snakemake and Nextflow are,
  and what the advantages of formal pipelines written with these are.
- What the nf-core initiative is, and how you can run one of their pipelines at OSC.

#### Required readings

- Perkel 2019, Nature "Toolbox" feature:
  [Workflow systems turn raw data into scientific knowledge](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-019-02619-z)
- Di Tommaso et al. 2017, Nature Biotechnology:
  [Nextflow enables reproducible computational workflows](https://www.nature.com/articles/nbt.3820)
- Ewels et al. 2020, Nature Biotechnology:
  [The nf-core framework for community-curated bioinformatics pipelines](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-020-0439-x)
